title: Natural Graphite’s Role in Tier‑1 Anode Supply
gist: This is a member-only video page for a Benchmark Summit 2026 London session on natural graphite's role in tier-1 anode supply, led by Mark Thompson and tagged with Talga. Its only content is three framing lines: graphite is the supply chain's weak link, anodes are the next raw-materials battleground, and it is unclear whether the West can scale anode supply.

insights.claim: A Benchmark Summit 2026 London session on natural graphite's role in tier-1 anode supply framed graphite as the overlooked anode material and the weak link in the battery supply chain.
insights.speaker: Mark Thompson, Founder and Managing Director, Benchmark
insights.so_what: If graphite is the binding constraint, anode-material suppliers outside China may get pricing power and policy support.
insights.quote: The overlooked anode: why graphite is the supply chain's weak link
insights.locator: The overlooked anode: why graphite is

insights.claim: The graphite session framed anodes as the next battleground in battery raw materials.
insights.speaker: Mark Thompson, Founder and Managing Director, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Investor and policy attention may shift from lithium and nickel toward anode supply, which favours graphite developers.
insights.quote: Anodes in focus: the next battleground in battery raw materials
insights.locator: Anodes in focus: the next battleground

insights.claim: The graphite session asked whether the West can scale anode supply to break the graphite bottleneck; the page leaves the question open and gives no answer.
insights.speaker: Mark Thompson, Founder and Managing Director, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Western anode capacity build-out is an open question, so execution risk for non-Chinese graphite and anode projects stays high.
insights.quote: Breaking the graphite bottleneck: can the west scale anode supply?

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a keynote billing the Texas Smackover as "America's Lithium Leviathan", which presents the Smackover brine as a major prospective source of US domestic lithium supply.
insights.speaker: Mark Thompson, Founder and Managing Director, Benchmark
insights.so_what: US brine lithium from the Smackover is being pitched as a large domestic supply source, which is worth tracking for North American lithium project developers.
insights.quote: The Texas Smackover: America's Lithium Leviathan
